integrations.name: Amazon API Gateway
integrations.description: A dashboard for Amazon API Gateway, from CloudWatch metrics.
integrations.details:
## Setup

1. Stream CloudWatch metrics to Kloudfuse through Kinesis Firehose: [AWS CloudWatch Metrics Integration](https://docs.kloudfuse.com/platform/latest/integration/aws/cloudwatch-metrics/).
2. Include the `AWS/ApiGateway` namespace in the metric stream, or stream all namespaces.
3. API Gateway publishes stage-level metrics by default; per-route metrics need detailed metrics: see [CloudWatch Enablement Reference](https://docs.kloudfuse.com/platform/latest/reference/aws/cloudwatch/#api-gateway-detailed-metrics).

integrations.description: Kafka broker, request and consumer metrics from the Datadog agent.
integrations.details:
## Setup

Collected by the Datadog agent. See [Datadog integrations: Message Queues & Streaming](https://docs.kloudfuse.com/platform/latest/reference/datadog/integrations/message-queues/).

Enable the `kafka` and `kafka_consumer` checks on the pods to monitor with an Autodiscovery annotation such as `ad.datadoghq.com/<container>.check_names: '["kafka", "kafka_consumer"]'`.

The broker check reads JMX, so the agent needs JMX access to the brokers.

integrations.name: Kubernetes
integrations.description: Cluster, node and job dashboards with pod, workload and node alerts, from the Datadog agent.
integrations.details:
## Setup

Collected by the Datadog agent. See [Kubernetes with the Datadog Agent](https://docs.kloudfuse.com/platform/latest/integration/dd-agent/kubernetes/).

Node and workload metrics come from the agent's built-in Kubernetes checks once it runs as a DaemonSet with the Cluster Agent; no annotations are needed.
alerts: Some nodes are not in ready condition for last 5 minutes
Some nodes have consistent high CPU usage for last 5 minutes
Host disk device has > 90% usage for last 5 minutes
More than 20% of nodes are unschedulable for last 15 minutes
Some K8S deployment(s) have lesser replicas available than desired for last 15 minutes
Some K8S pods are restarting for last 5 minutes
Some K8S pods are in crashloopbackoff for last 10 minutes
Some K8S pods are in failed state for last 5 minutes
Some pods are experiencing imagepullbackoff for last 10 minutes
Some K8S pods are using more CPU in the last 5 minutes
Some K8S pods are using more memory in last 5 minutes
Some K8S statefulset(s) have lesser replicas ready than desired for last 15 minutes

integrations.name: Kubernetes
integrations.description: Cluster, node and job dashboards with pod and workload alerts, from the OpenTelemetry collector.
integrations.details:
## Setup

Collected by the OpenTelemetry Collector. See [Kubernetes with the OpenTelemetry Collector](https://docs.kloudfuse.com/platform/latest/integration/otel/kubernetes/).

Run the collector as a DaemonSet with the Kubernetes and system-level metrics receivers enabled.
dashboards: Kubernetes Jobs and CronJobs Overview - OTel
alerts: Some K8S deployment(s) have lesser replicas available than desired for last 15 minutes - OTel
Some K8S pods are restarting for last 5 minutes - OTel
Some K8S pods are in failed state for last 5 minutes - OTel
Some K8S pods are using more CPU in the last 5 minutes - OTel
Some K8S pods are using more Memory in last 5 minutes - OTel
Some K8S statefulset(s) have lesser replicas ready than desired for last 15 minutes - OTel
